_note: When the mess serves, as told to us on 14 Sep 2026. Breakfast runs half an hour later on Saturday and Sunday; nothing else changes at the weekend. The menu itself is in menu.json and is a two-week rotation. If these times are ever posted somewhere official, replace this file and say where it came from.

cycle._note: The menu alternates Week-1 / Week-2: count whole weeks from the anchor, even means Week-1 and odd means Week-2. The mess is back on its September menu from Monday 2 November 2026 (it ran its older menu 19 Oct - 1 Nov). Mon 2 Nov = Week-1 is a GUESS, not read off the wall: if the wall says Week-2 this week, set anchor_monday to 2026-10-26. Saved menus: data/mess/saved/menu-2026-09.json (September, first anchor Mon 14 Sep = Week-1) and menu-2026-10.json (the older menu, anchor Mon 19 Oct = Week-1). To switch: copy one over menu.json, set the anchor to the Monday the mess restarts it, run tools/build_mess.py. tools/check_mess.py already knows each menu's merged cells.

report._note: Who to tell when a dish is wrong. Deliberately a name and not a link: anyone in the mess who would bother reporting it already knows how to reach him, and a phone number on a public page is a different decision.

trial._note: A bounded window where reporting is the POINT, not a complaint box. Framing it as a trial is what gets people to tap - nobody files a bug against a menu, but plenty of people will help test one. When `until` passes the page stops asking and says the trial is over; read the results with tools/mess_reports.py.
